{{Quote|Hey, I knew old Droz wouldn't leave us to rot under the yoke of these Imperials.|A freighter pilot|<ref name="SWG:RtF">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Rescue the Freighter|Dantooine system}}</ref>}}
'''Droz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] businessman who lived during the during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was managing the [[Dantooine Space Station]].<ref name="SWG:DSS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Droz appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DSS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Droz was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:DSS" /> The Whiphid was identified as Droz in the Rebel Alliance space mission "Rescue the Freighter,"<ref name="SWG:RtF" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes: 29 November 04|Publish 11.3]]" update on [[November 29]], [[2004]].<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=291|text=Update Notes: - November 29, 2004 - Publish 11.3}}</ref>
